title: A herd held a season. CTRL with only kangaroo allowed, the tool's groups on so the wave present at load is detached, coupling off; every 3,000 ticks every wild kangaroo's leave countdown is raised to 100,000 so the herd cannot leave, and its hunger, thirst, stored fat, wound count, position and current job are printed. 100,800 ticks, a full season. Does a held herd graze, breed, starve, fight, stand still, or do anything odd past sixty thousand ticks?
fork: v5.7 hold: whether a season-long hold is safe for the animals and the map, and what the stuck sweep must look for.

predictions.model: wild grazers are fed by the map
predictions.expects: hunger and thirst timers stay bounded, stored fat does not fall to zero, no death, positions keep changing
stored fat falls monotonically and a kangaroo dies or wounds appear with no combat
positions stop changing for thousands of ticks with no job
new kangaroo ids with a mother set appear in units.tsv

kill_criterion: no starvation, no freeze, no death without a combat report over a season means the hold is safe; a freeze defines the stuck sweep; a starvation bounds the hold length
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: held
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n=0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.layer=='land' and e.inEmbark then cfg.allow[e.key]=(e.token=='KANGAROO'); if e.token=='KANGAROO' then cfg.assign[e.token]={0,1,2,3}; n=n+1 end end end; cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); print(('roster: kangaroo only (%d allowed, %d applied); groups on (to detach the wave on the map at load), coupling off, ecology off; rotation enabled'):format(n,act))

do: local ks={}; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isWildlife(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and not u.flags1.inactive and df.creature_raw.find(u.race).creature_id=='KANGAROO' then ks[#ks+1]=u end end; local held=0; for _,u in ipairs(ks) do if u.animal.leave_countdown < 100000 then u.animal.leave_countdown=100000; held=held+1 end end; local parts={}; for _,u in ipairs(ks) do local w=0; for _,wd in ipairs(u.body.wounds) do w=w+1 end; parts[#parts+1]=('%d@%d,%d,%d h%d t%d fat%d w%d cd%d'):format(u.id,u.pos.x,u.pos.y,u.pos.z,u.counters2.hunger_timer,u.counters2.thirst_timer,u.counters2.stored_fat,w,u.animal.leave_countdown) end; print(('e19 herd: %d kangaroos, %d countdowns raised | %s'):format(#ks,held,table.concat(parts,' ; ')))

local n,g=0,0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isWildlife(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and df.creature_raw.find(u.race).creature_id=='KANGAROO' then n=n+1; local j=u.job.current_job; if j then g=g+1 end end end; local jobs={}; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isWildlife(u) and df.creature_raw.find(u.race).creature_id=='KANGAROO' and u.job.current_job then jobs[#jobs+1]=df.job_type[u.job.current_job.job_type] end end; print(('e19 jobs: %d kangaroos, %d with a job: %s'):format(n,g,table.concat(jobs,',')))
